knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The group rate starts from the one-to-one anchor and is then tested against hourly earnings. Competitor prices and member willingness do not give a tested figure.
Unlimited access makes sessions seem less valuable and cuts average income per session. The lesson does not claim it is always illegal.
40 per cent of 90 is 36 per member. Four paying members at 36 units is 144 units per hour, which is more than 90.

practicalCriteria: Given a one-to-one rate and a fill-rate estimate, the learner calculates group hourly earnings, and the assessor recalculates the figure
The learner writes a comparison showing whether the group rate beats one-to-one, using the average fill rate
The learner leaves out each consumer-law and GST point where advice has not been obtained
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Checks list with a source for each point
stopWorkCriteria: Stop publication of any group rate that has not been tested against one-to-one hourly income
Stop publication of pack terms that are unclear on expiry or inclusions
